prompt: Use case: production enemy body candidate for a 2D Unity survivor game. ENEMY-009, Militia Shieldbearer, a very durable slow frontline pursuer from the Royal Road. ONE isolated full-body human sprite on a genuinely transparent square canvas, no ground shadow. Three-quarter top-down orthographic gameplay view, facing RIGHT and slightly toward viewer; neutral compact animation-ready stance, both boots on one horizontal contact line. Broad heavy torso, planted short stance, one LARGE battered rectangular blue-grey shield held close in front-right of his body as the dominant silhouette, other hand with a short blunt sidearm tucked close. Worn militia armor and quilted burgundy/ochre cloth, less noble than the royal captain, stern determined expression. Readable instantly at 256px as a shield wall that takes many hits; shield must not entirely hide face and torso. Compact silhouette suitable for one centered circular contact profile; no long spear or far protruding weapon. Warm ironic fairy-tale chase, 2D hand-drawn storybook cutout, chunky 3–5 large forms, thick slightly irregular charcoal-plum outline, simple cel shading, matte muted colors, subtle paper texture. Body spans about 70–78% canvas height with generous true-alpha margin. No battle effects, arrows, text, scenery, frame, pixel art, pseudo-3D rendering or green goblin skin.
